title: MECHANICAL PROPERTIES OF MATERIALS
description: Examines mechanical behavior of materials, relating laboratory test results to material structure and elements of mechanical analysis.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MATS 321, 321H or NSE 321.
A minimum grade of C is required in MATS 321, MATS 321H and NSE 321.
meeting_html: TR 8:30am-9:50am in DEAR 118 - Dearborn Hall 118 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
